Re: The Maids Of Selma

Where did this come from? Who wrote this lovely tune?

↳ Posted by David Levine on September 2nd, 2022.

Re: The Maids Of Selma

David, it’s in both O’Neill’s Music of Ireland and the Roche Collection. Composer seems lost to time.

↳ Posted by gimpy on September 2nd, 2022.

Re: The Maids Of Selma

This tune has slightly slide-like featues and phrasing rather like Dan Collin’s Father’s Jig. I wonder if it is related musically, as they sound similar to me. Maybe a long-lost jumpity old hop jig couples dance once connected them in piping days, and further separation was then by fiddlers adding ornaments going in one direction and by fluters making spaces to breathe going in another as the dance steps were forgotten. Are there any more jigs phrased like this?

↳ Posted by RJH on December 11th, 2022.

Yes. 1st part ~= Dan Collin’s father’s jig’s 1st part, at any rate.
